findings.title: Invalid Ruby syntax `<%- end if %>` causes template compilation/runtime error
findings.body: In `app/views/embed/best.html.erb` line 6, the conditional block is closed with `<%- end if %>`. `end if` is not valid Ruby syntax for closing an `if` block (unless followed by a modifier condition) and will raise a `SyntaxError` when Rails compiles and renders the `embed/best` template. Replace `<%- end if %>` with `<%- end %>`.

findings.title: Posts with `raw_html` cook_method bypass HTML sanitization when edited by users
findings.body: `Post#cook` returns `raw` directly without sanitization or filtering whenever `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`. While initial creation happens through `TopicEmbed.import`, the resulting post is a normal first post in a forum topic that can be edited by its author (`embed_by_username`) or any moderator/admin, or even wiki-edited if made a wiki. Any subsequent edit through standard post revision (`PostRevisor`) keeps `cook_method` as `raw_html` and sets `cooked = raw` verbatim, allowing unsanitized `<script>` tags and arbitrary HTML (stored XSS) into the forum and the embed view. Furthermore, RSS feed contents in `PollFeed` are not sanitized at all before being imported with `raw_html`, so any script or event handler in the RSS feed is rendered directly inside Discourse.

findings.title: `PollFeed#poll_feed` crashes with `NoMethodError` when RSS items use `<description>` instead of `<content>`
findings.body: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb` line 35, `i.content.scrub` is called unconditionally on each item returned by `SimpleRSS`. Standard RSS 2.0 feeds typically populate `i.description` (or `i.content_encoded`) rather than `i.content`, leaving `i.content` as `nil`. Calling `.scrub` on `nil` raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'scrub' for nil:NilClass` and aborts the entire feed polling job.

findings.title: `TopicEmbed.import` mutates the caller's `contents` string in place
findings.body: `TopicEmbed.import` appends the `imported_from` footer using `contents << ...`, mutating the string passed by the caller (and will raise `RuntimeError: can't modify frozen String` if a frozen string is passed). Use `contents = contents + ...` instead of `<<`.

findings.title: Loop variable `post` overwrites the topic's root post and breaks subsequent iterations on failure
findings.body: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` line 148, `post` holds the root post created by `TopicEmbed.import_remote`. Inside the `t[:posts].each` loop on line 174, `post = PostCreator.new(post_user, attrs).create` overwrites that outer `post` variable. If `PostCreator#create` fails validation (for example, a short comment failing `min_post_length`, since `skip_validations: true` is not passed), `post` becomes an unsaved post or `nil`, and `post.post_number` / `post.topic_id` on subsequent iterations (and `post.topic` on line 177) will either be `nil` or raise a `NoMethodError`. Additionally, `attrs` passes `cooked: p[:cooked]`, which `PostCreator#setup_post` ignores.

findings.title: Using `Kernel#open` on `url` allows command injection / local file read if URL validation is bypassed
findings.body: In `TopicEmbed.import_remote` (line 48) and `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` (line 29), `open(...)` from `open-uri` is called directly. `TopicEmbed.import_remote` does not validate that `url` begins with `http://` or `https://` before calling `open(url).read` (the regex check only happens later inside `TopicEmbed.import`). If a caller passes a string starting with `|` or a local path (e.g. from a Disqus XML file `<link>` element in `disqus.thor` or `feed_polling_url`), `Kernel#open` can execute arbitrary shell commands or read local files. Parse with `URI.parse` and restrict to `URI::HTTP`/`URI::HTTPS` before opening.

findings.title: Unescaped `request.referer` interpolated into JavaScript string in `embed.html.erb`
findings.body: In `app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb` line 11, `<%= request.referer %>` is interpolated directly inside a single-quoted JavaScript string literal: `parent.postMessage(..., '<%= request.referer %>')`. Although `ensure_embeddable` checks `URI(request.referer).host`, the path or query portion of a valid URI can still contain characters (or `</script>`) that break out of the JS string or script block when rendered into HTML. Use `to_json` / `escape_javascript` or construct the origin from the validated scheme, host, and port.
